title: L4 Direction Scoring: Old vs New Methodology
old_method: Search second half of text for positive/negative keywords
new_method: Find Section 6 (Expected Results) marker, search within window
interpretation: Spot check is too small to reliably distinguish methods. The new scorer is more semantically grounded (looks at the actual prediction location) but can be fooled by mixed predictions in Section 6 itself.
implication: If the new (section-aware) scorer is more accurate, the 'knowing-doing gap' largely disappears. This is a substantive methodological finding that should be addressed in the paper.
recommendation: Report BOTH scoring methods in the paper; treat ΔKD as scoring-method-dependent; present the comparison as evidence that L4 is hard to measure reliably.
